name: Ozi Internal Link Booster — Auto SEO Interlinking Lite
author: Simmi Ahuja

sections.description:
Ozi Internal Link Booster is a lightweight internal linking helper designed to improve on-site SEO without unnecessary complexity or performance overhead.

By mapping keywords to target URLs, the plugin helps improve internal link structure, distribute link equity more effectively, and make site navigation clearer for both users and search engines.

Everything runs locally on your WordPress installation. No external APIs, no tracking, and no third-party services.

How it helps your SEO:

  • Keyword Mapping: Assign important keywords to specific URLs.
  • Optional Auto-Linking: Automatically inserts internal links based on your rules.
  • Orphan Page Detection: Identifies pages with zero incoming internal links.
  • Content Analysis: Highlights posts that need stronger internal linking.
  • Safe Engine: Skips headings (H1–H6), existing links, and code blocks to avoid over-optimization.

Optional Add-on: An optional add-on plugin is planned for advanced automation use cases. The Lite version is fully functional and usable on its own.

Features

  • Keyword → URL Mapping: Control anchor text and destination URLs.
  • Conservative Auto-Linking: Adds at most one link per keyword per post.
  • Global Controls: Limit the total number of auto-links per post.
  • Post Type Support: Choose where auto-linking is enabled (posts, pages, etc.).
  • SEO Dashboard: Overview of internal link score, orphan pages, and opportunities.
  • Editor Metabox: View internal link suggestions while editing posts.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Ozi Link Booster → Keywords to add keyword and URL mappings.
  4. Visit Ozi Link Booster → Settings to enable or configure auto-linking.
  5. Open the Dashboard to review your internal linking status.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin use any external APIs?

No. All analysis and linking logic runs locally on your WordPress site.

Is this plugin free to use?

Yes. The Lite version is fully functional and free to use.

Is there a Pro version?

An optional add-on plugin is planned for advanced automation use cases. The Lite version will remain fully functional on its own.

Will this over-optimize my content?

No. The auto-linking engine uses strict limits and skips headings and existing links to keep content natural.

Can I disable auto-linking and still use the dashboard?

Yes. You can disable auto-linking and use the dashboard for manual internal linking insights.
